title_as_printed: Progression of clinical diagnostic features and cognitive decline in mild cognitive impairment with Lewy bodies

blind_codes.Sample_N: 74 probable MCI-LB (69 at baseline + 5 at follow-up)

Task_Type.reason: Within the MCI-LB subtype, time-varying linear mixed models relate clinical features and biomarkers to ACE-R decline, and a multi-state Markov model describes how features accumulate. The study is correlational, with no classifier. T6 (descriptive clinical cohort) would also be arguable.

Category.reason: The registry's C5 captures the primary domain: clinical features, ACE-R and prospective clinical cohorts. The indicative imaging biomarkers also enter the primary models as time-varying predictors (Table 2): FP-CIT dopaminergic SPECT (neuroimaging, C1) and cardiac MIBG scintigraphy (peripheral, C6). These secondary domains are omitted. Readings: C5 alone, or C5 with C1/C6.
Category.quote: In the primary analysis, core clinical features and indicative biomarkers were included as time varying predictors of cognitive performance.

Validation_Type.reason: No predictive model is validated. Convention: V2.

Sample_N_Approx.reason: 69 cases classified at baseline plus 5 at follow-up give 74 probable MCI-LB.
Sample_N_Approx.quote: N = 69 individuals were classified as probable MCI-LB initially, with an additional five at follow-up, providing N = 74 total cases of probable MCI-LB

ADNI_Dependent.reason: Two prospective Newcastle MCI-LB cohorts; ADNI is not used.
